registers.label: Spare
lines: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?
He was despised, and we held him of no account.
Like a lamb led to the slaughter, he did not open his mouth.
He was wounded for our transgressions.
It is finished; he bows his head.
By his wounds we are healed.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: See the tree raised against the noon-dark sky, the wood, the nails, the King with thorns for a crown.
By his wounds we are healed.
He was despised and rejected, a man of sorrows acquainted with grief, and we hid our faces from him.
By his wounds we are healed.
Like a lamb led to the slaughter he was silent; he was wounded for our transgressions, crushed for our sins.
By his wounds we are healed.
It is finished, he says, and bows his head; through the torn curtain a new and living way is opened. Come, behold him.
By his wounds we are healed. Amen.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: The cross is lifted up against the darkened sky.
By his wounds we are healed.
Like a lamb led to slaughter, he opens not his mouth.
By his wounds we are healed.
It is finished; he bows his head.
By his wounds we are healed. Amen.
